pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
cons: One figure doing two different jobs.
redFlags: Ownership details missing from the public pages.
The demo promised in the pitch but buried in the flow.
A score and a community mood wearing the same number.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$200 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
9 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

bottomLine: The platform itself is workable - the dashboard, the demo and the two trading modes are all present. The caution applies to the claims around them, not the mechanics.
4.8 is our number, and it means the product works with conditions attached. The demo costs nothing; use it while the claims remain unproven.
